nodes.rationale: No install step needed: checks Python 3.10+, tkinter, deps; auto-creates .venv and restarts inside it.

nodes.label: Caption hashtag Tags
nodes.rationale: Hashtags written into EXIF XPKeywords so Windows Explorer shows/searches them; no re-encoding so quality unchanged; only .jpg tagged; dedup ignoring case.

nodes.label: Newest N posts with pinned-post handling
nodes.norm_label: newest n posts with pinned-post handling
nodes.rationale: Instagram lists up to 3 pinned posts first, so InstaKeep reads 3 extra posts and keeps the N newest by date.

nodes.label: Public profiles only, no login
nodes.rationale: No login; scraping goes against Instagram ToS, use only for profiles you have permission to archive.

nodes.label: Instagram rate-limit pauses
nodes.rationale: instaloader slows down on its own to stay under limits; if blocked, remaining users are skipped; per-user failures don't stop others.

nodes.label: Run lock (--run vs window)
nodes.rationale: A --run and the window never download at the same time; whichever starts second gives up.
